title: Shifting Social Dispositions, Stable Prosocial Traits: A Global Age-Period-Cohort Analysis of Human Personality
abstract: arXiv:2608.18119v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generational stereotypes are widespread, but they often rely on anecdotes, and it remains challenging to disentangle true birth-cohort differences from the universal effects of ageing and historical periods. Using a statistical approach that separates effects of age, calendar time, and cohort, we analyzed Big Five personality data (five broad dimensions of personality) from N=773,714 individuals assessed across 30 years. Traits that shape social interaction diverged between generations, whereas a prosocial core comprising morality, discipline, and emotional awareness was stable across cohorts. Generation Z (born between 1995 and 2012) showed lower excitement seeking and gregariousness alongside higher self-consciousness and anxiety. translated_title: 社会倾向的变迁与稳定亲社会特质：人类个性的全球年龄-时期-队列分析
translated_abstract: 代际刻板印象普遍存在，但它们往往依赖于轶事，并且将真正的出生队列差异与衰老和历时期的普遍影响区分开来仍具挑战性。我们采用一种分离年龄、日历时间和队列效应的统计方法，分析了跨越30年评估的N=773,714名个体的五大个性数据（个性的五个广泛维度）。塑造社会互动的特质在不同代际间出现分化，而包含道德、纪律和情感意识的亲社会核心在队列间保持稳定。Z世代（出生于1995年至2012年间）表现出较低的寻求刺激和合群性，同时具有较高的自我意识和焦虑水平。这些发现表明，队列变化是选择性的而非全局性的：人们与社会世界互动的方式可能正在适应当代文化条件，而核心特质保持稳定。
tldr: 该研究通过大规模数据分析发现，代际间社会互动倾向存在差异，但亲社会核心特质保持稳定，表明个性变化是选择性的而非全局性的。
en_tdlr: This study, using large-scale data analysis, finds that social interaction dispositions vary across generations while prosocial core traits remain stable, indicating that personality change is selective rather than global.
